rows.title: PDF bullet-list depth: a nested list item (an award's sub-point) was read as level 0
rows.summary: Now: a PDF list item whose marker sits right of an open item's, at or past where that item's text starts, is nested under it, so an award's or a certificate's sub-point comes back as its description, not an entry of its own. Markers at one x, centred items and right-aligned items stay siblings. The open items carry across a page break (a page ending in one full-width block), so a sub-point the break puts atop the next page still nests (review fix 0809fa6).
rows.product_call: Depth is inferred from x positions only; columns never carry open items across a page.

rows.title: PDF third-level '·' items glued onto their parent
rows.summary: Now: a '·' marker under a '–' item (the default Bullet style's third level) imports as a list item of its own; a line wrapped just before a typed '·' separator joins its item as before.

rows.title: Word list depth from List Bullet / List Bullet 2 / List Number styles
rows.summary: Now: a Word paragraph in List Bullet, List Bullet 2 (…) or List Number is a list item at its style's level.
rows.remaining: A paragraph in a custom list style whose numbering is only in styles.xml is still not read as a list item.

rows.title: Written-out address not linked on a line that also holds a file link
rows.summary: Now: a written-out address is a link even on a line that also holds a link from the file.

rows.title: Markdown link with a bold/italic/code label
rows.summary: Now: a Markdown link whose label is bold, italic or code imports as a link, the marks off its label.

rows.title: Markdown addresses lose underscores/asterisks; an address in a code span keeps a backtick
rows.summary: Now: an address in Markdown keeps its underscores and asterisks ("https://x.com/_foo_"), and one in a code span loses both backticks.

rows.title: A typed ' | ' inside a Markdown field splits the field
rows.summary: Now: an escaped "\|" in the Markdown is the user's character, never a field's edge: "R&D | Ops" stays the company, a headline and a place keep their "|". A place with a typed "|" ("Boston, MA | Remote", "London | Remote") is a place, so the contact line's location and a grouped employer's place come back whole (review fix 4319118), and the résumé's own name shows a typed "|" as "|", no placeholder (review fix 26101c3).
rows.product_call: lo-imp-markdown-escape-amp-pipe was stale and now checks the imported description (evidence in d228e26).
rows.remaining: Text and PDF imports have no escapes, so a typed ' | ' there still parts fields.

rows.title: Dashes inside Markdown heading fields; all-bold hand-written headings
rows.summary: Now: the export's "**Deloitte - Consulting** — *Engineer*" keeps the dash in the company; hand-written all-bold headings ("### **Software Engineer — Google**", with or without a "####" sub-heading) split into role and company; and a hand-written "**Acme - Engineer** — *Leeds, UK*", whose italic run is a place, splits at its dashes again, Acme's engineer, instead of the place becoming the company (review fix 1cdf617).
rows.product_call: A heading's italic run that is a place (and holds no role or school word) is read as hand-written. An export whose issuer happens to look like a place ("Amazon, Inc.") beside a dashed name splits as it did on master.
rows.remaining: IMP-REV-4 (not fixed, known limit): a lone bold run with a dash in a file with no two-field heading (a certificate or award with no issuer) still splits, and a project heading (exported without marks) "Foo - Bar" imports as name "Foo", technologies "Bar". Both are master behaviour, not regressions; a fix needs an export-side marker.

rows.title: CONIN$/CONOUT$/CLOCK$ reserved Windows file names
rows.summary: Now: a résumé named CONIN$, CONOUT$ or CLOCK$ exports as "CONIN$_resume", as "Con" does (exportFilename.js DEVICE regex).
rows.product_call: The reserved-name risk is on the export file name; nothing on the import side uses it.

issues.resolution: Confirmed by reading headingFields: a two-run heading was never checked. Fixed in 1cdf617 (italic run that is a place → split as before); test 105-r5-imp-md-heading-place, fail-first 36520914838.

Confirmed: PLACE failed on the U+FDD0 placeholder. Fixed in 4319118 (PLACE also accepts places joined by a typed '|'), covering the contact line, a grouped employer's place and the education place test; test 105-r5-imp-typed-pipe-place, fail-first 36520914838.
Confirmed: resume.name was built from personal.name before untyped(). Fixed in 26101c3; test 105-r5-imp-typed-pipe-resume-name, fail-first 36520914838.
Confirmed as a missed case, but master behaviour (not a regression) with no unambiguous import-side signal; left open as remaining on R5-IMP-02.
Confirmed: open list items reset per page block. Fixed in 0809fa6 (carry across a page break between full-width blocks); test 105-r5-imp-pdf-list-depth-page-break, fail-first 36520914838.
